titleNative: 寡黙だけどめちゃくちゃノリのいい黒猫ちゃん
synonyms: Taciturn But Absurdly Enthusiastic Black Cat–chan
The Quiet but Incredibly Spirited Black Cat Girl
A quiet but extremely cheerful black cat
synopsis: I thought Kuroi-san, the classmate sitting next to me, was quiet, but she turns out to be a cheerful girl with a cat-like charm!? Akama-kun, the protagonist aiming for a fresh start in high school, keeps trying to become popular but always ends up fumbling instead. Kuroi-san, the cat-like girl who’s been giving him cold stares, is actually incredibly lively — and by wholeheartedly going along with his clumsy invitations, she helps to brighten up the lives of Akama-kun and their classmates. A cat-themed romantic comedy with a surprising twist that took social media by storm! (Source: Square Enix, translated) Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was then licensed by Square Enix for serialization on 2025-12-27.

synopsis: Sena Satou, a medical researcher, finds herself lost in a different world - and she is not the only one! After managing to start a new life as the medicine-man "Sena," she encounters a mysterious man. He is the demon lord Delmatitidis, a man of immense beauty and strong magics, but physically sickly and weak. He recognizes Sena's knowledge and experience in herbal medicine, and she becomes his personal apothecary. As they share time together, they form an unforgettable bond and soon the two are drawn to each other. A doting romance that will change the destiny of a genius but nerdy apothecary and the handsome demon lord! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synonyms: The Exiled Lady Travels to Another World in a Camper Van While Crafting
synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)
